An old drugstore favorite of mine was Lash Stylist (Now discontinued by Maybelline and selling on amazon/ebay for $50+) and this is the closest thing I've ever found. The applicator/comb is very similar. The formula is a beautiful wet and shiny black that coats lashes individually, lengthens and volumizes, holds a curl the entire day, and doesn't budge. Difficult to remove...tried sleeping with it on overnight to see if I could get two-days-worth out of it, and that was a no. (Did not find it on my pillow case either.)  Does not lose 'flakes' during the day like waterproof mascara can.  It did come off quite easily after a steamy shower...and it comes off in chunks...does not 'melt' off.  Did not come

reviews.t: STOP BUY THIS NOW!!! absolutely great stuff!!
reviews.x: I've been looking for this masscarra for over 30 years. Another company made it but stopped. I have short bone straight facing down eye lashes. I've bought all kinds of masscarra  even a few comb on when I could find it but NOTHING worked like my old masscarra  UNTIL THIS!! I JUST TOOK OUT OF MAIL BOX TRIED IT CAME BACK ON AMAZON AND ORDERED TWO MORE. I'm telling you if your eye lashes are like mine you absolutely have to order this...it's like stepping back in time for me. I knew right away thi

reviews.t: Lasts all day with no flaking
reviews.x: Very happy with this purchase. US and UK brands stopped making comb-wand mascaras, and the few left in the market are four or five times the price of this Cezanne brand. The liquid is thinner than other mascaras but that helps the wand separate lashes and it doesn't clump. The color is true black and it lasts all day with no smudging or flaking.
I've been looking for a mascara like this since Max Factor quit making Lash Maker. This is a comb on and it makes my straight sparse eyelashes look long and curled.

The brush is flat and there is a bit of a comb, the formula is wet and a little thick, the color I had is black. I have very thin and sparse lashes and after several hours, it comes off in flakes and gets all over my face which I do not like, but it is a good mascara because it does not itritate my lashes and smudge.I only bought it to try out since it was unique, but it's messy coming off and a bit hard to get off with cold water, you have to use warm. Maybe not for those who like drier formula

reviews.t: Seriously the freaking best mascara ever!!
reviews.x: Great flat comb instead of a bulky brush. It is literally like combing/painting on long thin curled false lashes. It's awesome on bottom lashes and can get sooo close to the lash root that it also tight lines your eyes. Plus I put it through the ultimate test, I went to Zumba and sweat and everything and it all stayed on and In place with no smears or flaking. I love this mascara, I think I finally found my Holy Grail Mascara that I've been searching for, for years!

Update Aug 2018: New formulation? Doesn't apply well.  Clumpy and doesn't lengthen like previous version I bought.  Also the wand looks different from my last tube and doesn't look like photo.  Not buying again.  Earlier review Pros -applies easily -lengthens lashes -very black  CON: -MAIN CON it's difficult to remove this with make up remover, other oily solvent (like olive oil), or with soap/cleanser/water.  Have lost a few lashes :( -heavy, wet formula weighing down lashes --- undoes curl -do

LOVE the comb!  I have super-light , long eyelashes and used Maybelline Lash Blast because of the comb...this stuff is 1000X better.  One swipe and wow!  The comb is the trip, slightly bent with comb tines all away around.  However, it does not come off easily, or sometimes not at all, with oily mascara remover.  It comes off in the shower though.  I'm a "mature" lady and I finally found my dream mascara...and only 7 bucks!  I have 3 more on the way!  Wish it came in brown!

This is great stuff. It took "forever" to arrive, but it goes on easily and STAYS ON all day and even the next AM still looks good. No flaking! No running , its almost as if its waterproof but it isnt. I used coconut oil to help get it off the first time but it will come off inthe shower with warm water. I used to use maybelline comb on for many years and then they stopped making it :(  This is the best I have found anywhere.

reviews.t: Comb wand is not as described/ pictured
reviews.x: I was really hoping this mascara was going to work but unfortunately it didn't quite work out. The gaps in between the comb barely open up halfway, making it close to impossible to actually get the product onto your eyelashes all the way. The shipping also took over a month.

Excellent mascara.  Easy to apply, the comb makes huge lashes, no clumping.  My only criticism is, it takes a lot of water to remove, unlike Blinc, which could be a positive if need a waterproof mascara. Overall, love it!

This mascara is garbage. It is so hard to remove. I have lost several eyelashes each time I remove the mascara. Be advised. Also my eyes looked bloodshot at the end of a full day wearing this mascara.

reviews.t: The best at a fraction of the price
reviews.x: After looking far and wide for a mascara with a comb (the kind I used to get got discontinued) I found this. I absolutely love it! And its so cheap! I will be buying again! My lashes look fake!
I love this because I barely have eyelashes and it makes mine pop. Love it

reviews.t: I think it would stay on for years!
reviews.x: This mascara will do as the listing describes... However it is very, very difficult to remove.  I tried baby oil, soap and water and finally coconut oil.  It finally came off... and rather uncomfortably so... no doubt thanks to the combination of all three methods I used.  This mascara seemed to harden on my lashes so that it was actually somewhat painful as it felt like something was poking the my eye lid at the base of the lashes... I imagine this was because of the fact that this product does

reviews.t: Could be a 5 star mascara - if the teeth would be slightly longer
reviews.x: I bought this product, because I enjoyed comb mascaras from other manufacturers in the past, and they usually do an amazing job, especially for the lower eyelashes. With this particular brand it's a hate/love relationship. The comb teeth could be longer. It takes ages to get sufficient mascara on and around my lashes. If the teeth would just be a bit longer, it would be way faster. However, I LOVE this mascara as a primer. It beautifully separates the lashes. I use this mascara first for about t

reviews.t: the fibers fall and are easy to brush off
reviews.x: I was somewhat worried about purchasing a foreign mascara...but this one beats all others I have tried! I believe it's fiber bases, so it leaves ZERO black streaks or raccoon eyes. When it starts to "fade away", the fibers fall and are easy to brush off. I love length more than anything in a mascara, ant this one is crazy insane! One coat can give you a beautiful natural look, two or three can up the ante! I don't curl my lashes but I bet adding that would do wonders! I actually use the

reviews.t: I'll start with the positive-this works great for layering each lash on the bottom lid and ...
reviews.x: I'll start with the positive-this works great for layering each lash on the bottom lid and it can keep them separated nicely (it's competative to something that clinque sells called their lower lash mascara brush). However, the bristles or too short to capture the upper longer lashes-and it doesn't create any volume so if your lashes are straight or short then all you have is coated short and straight lashes. And the mascara does not come off with makeup remover, I had raccoon eyes; eventually g

I have very fine, straight lashes and used to use Maybelline Lash Stylist that had a comb applicator like this. The Lash Stylist was discontinued years ago and I have been trying to find another mascara that uses a comb, and I finally found this mascara. I really love it and it grabs every lash and adds thickness and volume. I think this would be great for all kinds of lashes.

reviews.t: Great looking lashes, but causes lash fallout.
reviews.x: Yes this delivers mascara and you can comb through for full thick lashes which look great. BUT I have to deduct 2 stars because when washing off (gently as usual) as I always get at least 1-2 lashes falling out from this mascara :( NOT cool. I'll keep the comb applicator since I can still use it to groom lashes / brows.

reviews.t: Still Deciding Whether This is "THE ONE"
reviews.x: I'm still deciding my ultimate rating of this product, as I have not put it to the TRUE test of all-day wear in hot, humid conditions of a Florida summer. I'm thrilled to have another mascara with a comb applicator, as my FAVORITE ( MAYBELLINE Lash Stylist Comb Waterproof Mascara, Very Black #611) has been discontinued.

Every time I find a good comb-on mascara it's discontinued so I'm thrilled to have found this!  It is the best mascara I've ever used hands down!  It goes on so smoothly it's amazing and it doesn't budge! I've slept in it and woke up with still perfect lashes.

This is a really good mascara, but it is the only mascara I have ever used that irritates my eyes, and I wear contact lenses. Must be the fibers. It works really well as long as you don't have a reaction...I'm super bummed I can't use it.

super awesome mascara. the brush allows for great separation and coating of individual lashes. this mascara does not smear or run whatsoever, but in warm water washes neatly off. it holds up really well for me and i have very oily lids

claims.text: Reviewers frequently praise the comb-style wand for separating lashes, lengthening, and avoiding clumps.
Many reviewers say it lasts all day with no flaking or running.
A common complaint is that it is difficult to remove, sometimes requiring oil or causing lash loss.
Several reviewers note it is a welcome replacement for discontinued comb-wand mascaras at a low price.
Some reviewers report problems with the wand or formula, including clumping, flaking, and a changed formula.
